explanation: The auxiliary contact TS 17-18 failed stuck closed and prevented transfer. Step 0: The controller indicated utility loss with transfer inhibited which matches false Emergency position feedback. Step 1: Continuity across the auxiliary contact TS 17-18 measured closed while the switch remained on Normal. Step 2: A fault free switch in this position would read open there so the closed reading proves the contact is stuck closed. With all power isolated and locked out, have an authorized person inspect the auxiliary contact TS 17-18 and repair or replace it as needed. Keep all safety functions active and do not operate under load.
